14.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_FIRST_TALK_001
14.description: I represent the interests of the nations in educating adventurers on the technologies available for strengthening the bonds between them.
14.translation_description: Rappresento le nazioni nel fornire agli avventurieri informazioni sulle tecnologie disponibili per rafforzare i legami tra loro.

15.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_FIRST_TALK_002
15.description: To that end, I would like to introduce to you the “linkshell.”

16.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_FIRST_TALK_003
16.description: A linkshell enables you to communicate with others over any distance, as if they were before your very eyes!
16.translation_description: Una fonoperla ti permette di comunicare con chiunque a qualsiasi distanza, come se ti fosse davanti agli occhi!

17.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_FIRST_TALK_004
17.description: You may have as many as eight linkshells open at any given time, allowing you to communicate simultaneously with any number of people. The only time your physical presence is required is...well, never!
17.translation_description: Puoi tenere attive fino a otto fonoperle alla volta e comunicare con molte persone contemporaneamente. Ti basta essere presente di persona soltanto... beh, mai!

18.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_FIRST_TALK_005
18.description: Would you care to give it a try? I can create a personal linkshell for you now, if you like.
18.translation_description: Ti andrebbe di provare? Se vuoi, posso creare subito una fonoperla personale per te.

19.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_MAIN_TALK_001
19.description: Would you like to learn more about linkshells? Or are you perhaps interested in creating your own?
19.translation_description: Vuoi saperne di più sulle fonoperle? O magari vuoi crearne una?

20.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_MAINMENU_Q1_000_1
20.description: What would you like to do?

21.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_MAINMENU_A1_000_1
21.description: Hear a basic explanation of linkshells.
21.translation_description: Ascolta una spiegazione di base sulle fonoperle.

22.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_MAINMENU_A2_000_1
22.translation_description: Scopri come si usano le fonoperle.

23.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_MAINMENU_A3_000_1
23.description: Create, rename, or disband a linkshell.
23.translation_description: Crea, rinomina o sciogli una fonoperla.

25.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_GUIDEMENU_TALK_001
25.description: What would you like to learn more about?

27.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_GUIDEMENU_A1_000_1
27.description: How do I create a linkshell?

28.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_GUIDEMENU_A2_000_1
28.description: How do I invite others to join my linkshell?
28.translation_description: Come posso invitare altri a unirsi alla mia fonoperla?

29.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_GUIDEMENU_A3_000_1
29.description: How do I join a linkshell?
29.translation_description: Come posso unirmi a una fonoperla?

30.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_GUIDEMENU_A4_000_1
30.description: How do I communicate using a linkshell?
30.translation_description: Come si comunica tramite una fonoperla?

31.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_GUIDEMENU_A5_000_1
31.description: Who are linkshell leaders and masters?
31.translation_description: Chi sono i leader e i maestri delle fonoperle?

32.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_GUIDEMENU_A6_000_1
32.description: How do I quit a linkshell?

33.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_GUIDEMENU_A7_000_1
33.description: How do I disband a linkshell?

35.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_PROCEDUREMENU_TALK_001
35.description: Excellent! Shall I create a new linkshell for you? Or do you wish to make changes to an existing one?
35.translation_description: Perfetto! Vuoi che ti crei una nuova fonoperla o preferisci apportare modifiche a una che hai già?

36.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_PROCEDUREMENU_Q1_000_1
36.description: What would you like to do?

39.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_PROCEDUREMENU_A3_000_1
39.description: Promote a member to linkshell master.
39.translation_description: Promuovi un membro a maestro della fonoperla.

42.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_FIRST_GUIDE_001
42.description: A linkshell enables you to communicate with others over any distance, as if they were before your very eyes!
42.translation_description: Una fonoperla ti permette di comunicare con chiunque a qualsiasi distanza, come se ti fosse davanti agli occhi!

43.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_FIRST_GUIDE_002
43.description: You may have as many as eight linkshells open at any given time, allowing you to communicate simultaneously with any number of people.
43.translation_description: Puoi tenere attive fino a otto fonoperle alla volta e comunicare con molte persone contemporaneamente.

44.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_FIRST_GUIDE_003
44.description: The only time your physical presence is required is...well, never!
44.translation_description: Ti basta essere presente di persona soltanto... beh, mai!

45.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_FIRST_GUIDE_004
45.description: Would you care to give it a try? I can create a personal linkshell for you now, if you like.
45.translation_description: Ti andrebbe di provare? Se vuoi, posso creare subito una fonoperla personale per te.

48.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_MAKE_GUIDE_001
48.description: If you wish to create a linkshell, you need only speak with a linkshell distributor like myself and register the name you desire.
48.translation_description: Per creare una fonoperla, ti basta rivolgerti a una distributrice di fonoperle come me e registrare il nome che desideri.

49.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_MAKE_GUIDE_002
49.description: Should your registration be approved, your linkshell will be created and you will be designated its master.
49.translation_description: Se la richiesta verrà approvata, la fonoperla sarà creata e tu ne diventerai <hex:02081BE905FF0B6C61206D616573747261FF0B696C206D61657374726F03>.

50.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_MAKE_GUIDE_003
50.description: As linkshell master, you can invite and remove other adventurers from your linkshell at will.
50.translation_description: In quanto <hex:020815E905FF086D616573747261FF086D61657374726F03> della fonoperla, puoi invitare altri avventurieri o rimuoverli dalla fonoperla quando vuoi.

53.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_ADD_GUIDE_001
53.description: If you are a master or a leader, you can invite other adventurers to join your linkshell at will.
53.translation_description: Se sei <hex:020835E905FF19756E61206D616573747261206F20756E61206C6561646572FF17756E206D61657374726F206F20756E206C656164657203>, puoi invitare altri avventurieri a unirsi alla tua fonoperla quando vuoi.

54.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_ADD_GUIDE_002_SYS
54.description: Only linkshell leaders and masters have the authority to invite other players.
54.translation_description: Solo i leader e i maestri delle fonoperle possono invitare altri giocatori.

55.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_ADD_GUIDE_003_SYS
55.description: To invite a player to join a linkshell, target him and select the name of that linkshell from the subcommand menu.
55.translation_description: Per invitare un giocatore a unirsi a una fonoperla, selezionalo e scegli il nome della fonoperla dal menu dei comandi.

56.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_ADD_GUIDE_004_SYS
56.description: You can also invite players by selecting their names in the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>social<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> interface and choosing a linkshell from the subcommand menu.
56.translation_description: Puoi anche invitare i giocatori selezionando i loro nomi dall'interfaccia <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>sociale<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e scegliendo una fonoperla dal menu dei comandi.

57.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_ADD_GUIDE_005
57.description: If he accepts your invitation, he will immediately become a member of your linkshell!
57.translation_description: Se accetta l'invito, diventerà subito membro della tua fonoperla!

58.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_ENTER_GUIDE_001
58.description: In order to join a linkshell, you must receive an invitation from that linkshell's master or one of its leaders.
58.translation_description: Per unirti a una fonoperla, devi ricevere un invito dal suo maestro o da uno dei suoi leader.

59.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_ENTER_GUIDE_002
59.description: If you choose to accept the invitation, you will become a member of the linkshell.
59.translation_description: Accettando l'invito, diventerai membro della fonoperla.

60.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_ENTER_GUIDE_003_SYS
60.description: When you receive an invitation to join a linkshell, you will be given the chance to view a list of its members.
60.translation_description: Quando ricevi un invito a unirti a una fonoperla, puoi consultare l'elenco dei suoi membri.

61.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_ENTER_GUIDE_004_SYS
61.description: However, until you select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Accept Linkshell Invite<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, you will not be able to send or receive messages through that linkshell.
61.translation_description: Tuttavia, finché non selezioni <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Accetta Invito a Fonoperla<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, non potrai inviare né ricevere messaggi tramite quella fonoperla.

62.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_CHAT_GUIDE_001
62.description: Conversing with others over linkshell is as easy as speaking with them in person.
62.translation_description: Conversare con gli altri tramite una fonoperla è semplice come parlare di persona.

63.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_CHAT_GUIDE_002_SYS
63.description: To send messages to members of a certain linkshell, select the speech bubble icon situated by the chat log, followed by the linkshell to designate it as the default chat mode.
63.translation_description: Per inviare messaggi ai membri di una fonoperla, seleziona l'icona a forma di fumetto accanto alla finestra della chat, poi scegli la fonoperla per impostarla come modalità chat predefinita.

64.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_CHAT_GUIDE_003_SYS
64.description: You can also change the default chat mode by selecting <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Linkshells<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> under <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Social<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> from the main menu, selecting a linkshell, and choosing <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Open Communication<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> from the subcommand menu.
64.translation_description: Puoi cambiare la modalità chat predefinita anche selezionando <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Fonoperle<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> nella sezione <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Social<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> dal menu principale, scegliendo una fonoperla e poi <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Apri Comunicazione<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> dal menu dei comandi.

65.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_LEADER_GUIDE_001
65.description: The linkshell master has the authority to invite and remove members, as well as rename and disband the linkshell.
65.translation_description: Il maestro della fonoperla può invitare o rimuovere membri, oltre a rinominare e sciogliere la fonoperla.

66.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_LEADER_GUIDE_002
66.description: The linkshell master can also designate other members as linkshell leaders, bestowing upon them the authority to invite and remove members.
66.translation_description: Il maestro della fonoperla può anche nominare leader tra gli altri membri, conferendo loro l'autorità di invitare e rimuovere membri.

67.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_LEADER_GUIDE_003
67.description: While the powers possessed by leaders and masters are similar, true authority still belongs to the linkshell master.
67.translation_description: I leader e i maestri hanno poteri simili, ma l'autorità finale spetta al maestro della fonoperla.

68.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_LEAVE_GUIDE_001
68.description: If you wish to withdraw from a linkshell, you may do so at any time.
68.translation_description: Se vuoi lasciare una fonoperla, puoi farlo in qualsiasi momento.

69.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_LEAVE_GUIDE_002_SYS
69.description: You can quit a linkshell by selecting <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Linkshells<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> under <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Social<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> from the main menu, selecting a linkshell, and choosing <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Quit Linkshell<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> from the subcommand menu.
69.translation_description: Puoi abbandonare una fonoperla selezionando <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Fonoperle<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> nella sezione <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Social<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> dal menu principale, scegliendone una e poi <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Abbandona Fonoperla<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> dal menu dei comandi.

70.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_LEAVE_GUIDE_003_SYS
70.description: Please note, however, that the linkshell master cannot resign without transferring his or her authority to another member.
70.translation_description: Il maestro, tuttavia, non può dimettersi senza prima trasferire la propria autorità a un altro membro.

71.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_LEAVE_GUIDE_004_SYS
71.description: You can transfer authority by selecting <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Linkshells<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> under <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Social<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> from the main menu, selecting a linkshell, selecting a player, and choosing <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Promote to Linkshell Master<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> from the subcommand menu.
71.translation_description: Puoi trasferire l'autorità selezionando <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Fonoperle<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> nella sezione <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Social<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> dal menu principale, scegliendo una fonoperla e un giocatore, poi selezionando <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Promuovi a Maestro Fonoperla<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> dal menu dei comandi.

72.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_LEAVE_GUIDE_005_SYS
72.description: In the event that you are the only member in the linkshell, you must instead disband your linkshell by speaking with a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>linkshell distributor<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
72.translation_description: Se nella fonoperla non ci sono altri membri oltre a te, invece, devi scioglierla parlando con un <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>distributore di fonoperle<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

73.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_BREAK_GUIDE_001
73.description: If you wish to disband a linkshell, you must speak with a linkshell distributor like myself. We will need to notify the other members so as to prevent confusion.
73.translation_description: Se vuoi sciogliere una fonoperla, devi parlare con una distributrice di fonoperle come me. Dovremo avvisare gli altri membri per evitare confusione.

74.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_MAKE_PROCEDURE_OK_000_1
74.description: One personal linkshell, coming right up! What name would you like to register?
74.translation_description: Una fonoperla personale, subito pronta! Che nome vuoi registrare?

75.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_MAKE_PROCEDURE_NG_000_1
75.description: It appears you are already a member of eight different linkshells. For your own safety, I cannot permit you to create another─the cacophony of voices constantly reverberating in your head would place undue stress upon your mental faculties.
75.translation_description: Mi dispiace, ma fai già parte di otto fonoperle. Non posso permetterti di crearne un'altra per la tua sicurezza: il continuo frastuono di voci che ti rimbomba in testa metterebbe a dura prova le tue facoltà mentali.

76.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_MAKE_SUCCESS_001
76.description: Congratulations! You are now the proud owner of your very own linkshell.
76.translation_description: Congratulazioni! Ora possiedi una fonoperla tutta tua.

77.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_NAMECHANGE_PROCEDURE_OK_000_1
77.description: I see. Which linkshell do you wish to rename?

78.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_NAMECHANGE_PROCEDURE_NG_000_1
78.description: I'm afraid that a linkshell can only be renamed by its master. Our records indicate that you are not <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503>.
78.translation_description: Mi dispiace, ma solo il maestro di una fonoperla può cambiarne il nome. Dai nostri registri risulta che tu non sei <hex:02081BE905FF0B6C61206D616573747261FF0B696C206D61657374726F03>.

79.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_NAMECHANGE_SUCCESS_001
79.description: It is done. I have altered your linkshell as per your request.
79.translation_description: Ho modificato il nome della tua fonoperla come richiesto.

80.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_BREAK_PROCEDURE_OK_000_1
80.description: These things happen. Which linkshell would you like to do away with?

81.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_BREAK_PROCEDURE_NG_000_1
81.description: I'm afraid that a linkshell can only be disbanded by its master. Our records indicate that you are not <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503>.
81.translation_description: Mi dispiace, ma solo il maestro di una fonoperla può scioglierla. Dai nostri registri risulta che tu non sei <hex:02081BE905FF0B6C61206D616573747261FF0B696C206D61657374726F03>.

82.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_BREAK_SUCCESS_001
82.description: Very well. I confess, I die a little inside every time I disband one of these.
82.translation_description: Va bene. Confesso che ogni volta che ne sciolgo una, mi si spezza un po' il cuore.

83.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_00005_PROMPT_MESSAGE0
83.description: Select a name for your linkshell.
83.translation_description: Scegli un nome per la tua fonoperla.

84.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_00005_PROMPT_MESSAGE1
84.description: Names must be between 3 and 20 letters or numbers. The following punctuation marks are also allowed:
84.translation_description: I nomi devono contenere da 3 a 20 lettere o cifre. Puoi usare anche i seguenti segni di punteggiatura:

86.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_00005_PROMPT_MESSAGE3
86.description: • Double spaces/underscores are not allowed.<hex:02100103>• A space cannot be used before or after the name.<hex:02100103>• Names consisting solely of punctuation marks are prohibited.
86.translation_description: • Non sono ammessi spazi doppi o trattini bassi consecutivi.<hex:02100103>• Il nome non può iniziare o terminare con uno spazio.<hex:02100103>• Non sono ammessi nomi composti soltanto da segni di punteggiatura.

91.name: TEXT_CMNDEFLINKSHELL_00006_00005_BREAK_WARNING
91.description: You are about to disband <hex:022903EA0203>. All members will be notified. You will not be able to restore this linkshell once it has been disbanded. Are you certain you wish to proceed?
91.translation_description: Stai per sciogliere <hex:022903EA0203>. Tutti i membri riceveranno una notifica e non potrai recuperare questa fonoperla dopo averla sciolta. Vuoi davvero procedere?
